plan: A gelatinous blob who slingshots himself from very far to knock up a whole team.
aSurveiller: His E (Elastic Slingshot). He winds up and jumps from very far: when he stretches, spread out from the landing zone.
contrer: When he stretches to jump (E), spread out from the landing zone.
Squash his little blobs: they heal him.
Interrupt his E with crowd control while he's charging it.
forces: Comes back to life with his passive.

sorts.P: Drops blobs that heal him; can reform.
sorts.Q: Grabs and slams two enemies together.

momentFort: Punishable early and slow to clear, but ganks from very far with his E from level 3. Very strong in the mid game.
